quest:Omar_Da_Ogar5.description: Bring Omar some new bait, I think he wants bugs...? Oh and some more bobjoepickles of course!

quest:Centurion7.description: Complete the Molten Colosseum within World 5

quest:Tired_Mole2.name: Like_taking_Keys_from_a_Crawler
quest:Tired_Mole2.description: Defeat Crawlers within the cave to get more Boss Keys. AFK kills count.

quest:Monolith1.name: Surface_Level_Jealousy
quest:Monolith1.description: Prove you know the Statue Man by leveling up Statues to Lv 250 total and bringing 17 different statues

quest:Monolith2.name: Onyx_Statue_Crafting
quest:Monolith2.description: Bring some statues to the monolith, and youll get to make ONYX STATUES!

quest:Royal_Worm1.name: Let_the_Tails_Hit_the_Floor
quest:Royal_Worm1.description: Fill all 3 platforms with worm tails.

quest:Royal_Worm2.name: Bothering_Mutants
quest:Royal_Worm2.description: Spawn and defeat 5 Mutated Mush monsters by dropping toxic sludge oil on those spores near town...

quest:Royal_Worm3.name: Royal_Score
quest:Royal_Worm3.description: By arcade, he means colosseum... get a score of 48,500,000

quest:Royal_Worm8.name: Normie_Bidding
quest:Royal_Worm8.description: Do all other Quests here in World 4.

item:Pearl1.name: Aqua_Pearl
item:Pearl1.description: Increases Fishing Spd by 30% 1% chance to be consumed every time you reel in a fish. Must be equipped in a Food Slot to give its bonus.

item:Jungle2.name: Snake_Skin
item:Jungle2.description: ''Theres a snake in me boots! Oh wait no, my boots are the snake!'' - Someone who wears snakeskin boots

item:Bug4.name: Fruitfly
item:Bug4.description: Hahaha I had my fingers crossed!

item:Bug7.name: Worker_Bee
item:Bug7.description: It's a bee and it's working. As per the Worker Bee Union Act of 1977, I am barred from making any pun or joke about them.

item:BobJoePickle.name: BobJoePickle
item:BobJoePickle.description: He was one of the good ones... Alas he is now just a pickle. Good for scaring a cat though!

item:Timecandy4.name: 12_HR_Time_Candy
item:Timecandy4.description: Twelve hours, that's a long time! Hold down to instantly get 12 Hour of AFK Gains.

item:Timecandy5.name: 24_HR_Time_Candy
item:Timecandy5.description: An entire day, just like that! Hold down to instantly get 24 Hour of AFK Gains.

item:Pearl6.name: Divinity_Pearl
item:Pearl6.description: Hold down to gain 40% EXP in the current skill you're doing! If you're in a town, you will gain EXP in the town skill. Only works on skills below level 50. IMPORTANT: This cannot be used for skills in World 5 or beyond.

item:Key5.name: Kruk's_Volcano_Key
item:Key5.description: Hold down to add these Plateau Boss Keys to your account.

item:SmithingHammerChisel3.name: Onyx_Tools
item:SmithingHammerChisel3.description: Drop this on the statue man, and you'll turn him to onyx and unlock the ability to trade in statues for Onyx rank!

item:EquipmentStatues1.name: Power_Statue
item:EquipmentStatues1.description: A stone statue sculpted in the likeness of an absolute unit. Give this to the Statue Man in return for some bonus stats.

item:EquipmentStatues6.name: Kachow_Statue
item:EquipmentStatues6.description: A stone statue named after the catch phrase of a very fast and very not real red car. Give this to the Statue Man in return for some bonus stats

item:Bullet3.name: Coldseeker_Bullet
item:Bullet3.description: Increases Weapon Power by 9. 5% chance to be consumed every time you defeat a monster. Must be equipped in a Food Slot to give its bonus.

item:Ladle.name: Cooking_Ladle
item:Ladle.description: Hold down to boost all your kitchens ahead by 1 hour for each ladle in this stack. The entire stack will be used up when you do.

item:Timecandy6.name: 72_HR_Time_Candy
item:Timecandy6.description: The LEGENDARY 72 Hour candy. Hold down to instantly get 30 Seconds of AFK Gai... just kidding, you'll get 72 Hours!

item:Pearl5.name: Holy_Pearl
item:Pearl5.description: Hold down to gain Class EXP. The amount you gain is based on your Class LV.
